Trace, implement and test: 04.12.Paths with Sum

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
/**
 * Definition for a binary tree node.
 * struct TreeNode {
 *     int val;
 *     TreeNode *left;
 *     TreeNode *right;
 *     TreeNode(int x) : val(x), left(NULL), right(NULL) {}
 * };
 */
class Solution {
public:
    int pathSum(TreeNode* root, int sum) {
        unordered_map<long long, int> cnt{{0, 1}};
        auto dfs = [&](this auto&& dfs, TreeNode* root, long long s) -> int {
            if (!root) {
                return 0;
            }
            s += root->val;
            int ans = cnt[s - sum];
            ++cnt[s];
            ans += dfs(root->left, s);
            ans += dfs(root->right, s);
            --cnt[s];
            return ans;
        };
        return dfs(root, 0);
    }
};
